title: eleutherococcus japonicus var. variegata
intro: Eleutherococcus japonicus var. variegata, commonly known as Japanese Ginseng or White Ginseng, is a plant species belonging to the Araliaceae family, native to East Asia. It has been traditionally used for its health benefits, including reducing stress and anxiety, improving cognitive function, and enhancing physical performance. The therapeutic actions of E. japonicus var. variegata include adaptogenic, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its ability to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of this plant include saponins, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
